directory.title: Rochester Institute of Technology Immersions and Minors

university_rule.summary: Declare an immersion through SIS: three related general-education courses, nine credit hours, outside the major with no overlap with program requirements. Programs cannot restrict students to a particular immersion or group. Restricted class sizes may require hosting-department approval; unavailable-course substitution requires offering-department consultation. Minor requirements are separate and are not imported into an immersion.
university_rule.interpretation: The directory is the observed published route set, not a prohibition on a later approved route or a completed course inventory.
